req_spec.title: UC-S3-001 Create Course with Default Resources
req_spec.scope: An approved student creates a course (title, description, colour); the system creates four default resource cards. Source: UniShare_Iteration_3.md Use Case 1 (UC-S3-001) and Sequence 1; src/server/api/routers/course.ts (create); src/components/courses/course-form.tsx; src/app/(student)/courses/new/page.tsx; middleware.ts; src/app/(student)/layout.tsx. Differences from the document: code has no course code / semester / icon fields; minimum title length is 1 (document: 2); an invalid colour is rejected, not defaulted; after creation the student is redirected to /courses (document: /courses/<id>).

requirement.title: Course title validation
requirement.description: Title is mandatory, 1 to 100 characters (input has maxLength 100; API z.string().min(1,'Title is required').max(100)). The form trims the title; an empty or whitespace-only title is not submitted and shows the message 'Please enter a course title'.

requirement.title: Course description validation
requirement.description: Description is optional, maximum 500 characters (textarea maxLength 500, API max(500)). An empty description is stored as no description.

requirement.title: Course colour
requirement.description: Colour is mandatory and chosen from 8 swatches (Purple, Blue, Green, Orange, Red, Pink, Teal, Indigo); the first (Purple #a855f7) is preselected. The API accepts only '#' followed by exactly 6 hex digits (case-insensitive) and otherwise returns 'Invalid color format'.

requirement.title: Four default resource cards
requirement.description: Creating a course automatically creates exactly 4 resource cards: Assignments (type ASSIGNMENT, files allowed), Tasks (TASK, no files), Content (CONTENT, files allowed), Notes (NOTES, no files).

requirement.title: Successful creation
requirement.description: After a valid submission the system shows 'Course created successfully!', redirects to /courses and the course appears under 'My Courses' with the creator as owner (role OWNER, createdBy = current user). Duplicate titles are allowed.

requirement.title: Only approved, logged-in students can create courses
requirement.description: Visitors who are not logged in are redirected to /login; users with role PENDING are redirected to /waiting-approval and cannot use /courses/new. The API requires a session (UNAUTHORIZED otherwise). Iteration 3 alternative flow A3 additionally requires a 403 'Your account is pending approval' from the server.

req_spec.title: Course management (list, open, edit, delete, favourite)
req_spec.scope: Owner and collaborator handling of an existing course. Source: UniShare_Iteration_3.md Use Case 1 postconditions and Data Dictionary (Course, Favorite); src/server/api/routers/course.ts (getAll, getUserCourses, getById, update, delete, toggleFavorite); src/app/(student)/courses/page.tsx, courses/[id]/page.tsx, courses/[id]/settings/page.tsx; src/components/courses/*.

requirement.title: Course list: owned and shared
requirement.description: /courses lists the student's own courses under 'My Courses' and courses where the student is an ACCEPTED collaborator under 'Shared With Me'. PENDING or REJECTED invitations and other students' courses are not listed. A student without courses sees 'No courses yet'.

requirement.title: Course access control
requirement.description: A course can be opened only by its owner or an ACCEPTED collaborator; the page shows the role badge OWNER / CONTRIBUTOR / VIEWER. Others get 'You don't have access to this course'; an unknown id gives 'Course not found' (page 'Course Not Found').

requirement.title: Edit course (owner only)
requirement.description: The owner can change title, description and colour in Course Settings > General (same validation as creation) and sees 'Course updated successfully!'. Any other user gets 'Only the course owner can update course details'; the settings page shows 'Access Denied - Only the course owner can access settings.' to non-owners. Clearing the description must remove it.

requirement.title: Delete course (owner only)
requirement.description: Course Settings > Danger Zone asks 'Are you sure you want to delete "<title>"? This action cannot be undone and will delete all resources and collaborator access.'. OK deletes the course with its resources, collaborators and favourites and shows 'Course deleted successfully'; Cancel changes nothing. Non-owners get 'Only the course owner can delete the course'.

requirement.title: Favourite toggle
requirement.description: The star on the course page toggles the favourite flag of the current student only (unique per student and course): 'Added to favorites' / 'Removed from favorites'. Favourites feed the timetable course list.

req_spec.title: Resource cards and files
req_spec.scope: Custom resource cards, deadlines and file attachments inside a course. Source: UniShare_Iteration_3.md Use Case 1 step 26 + Data Dictionary (ResourceCard, Resource); src/server/api/routers/resource.ts; src/components/resources/resource-form.tsx, resource-card.tsx, file-upload-modal.tsx; src/app/api/uploadthing/core.ts (courseResourceUploader); src/app/(student)/courses/[id]/page.tsx.

requirement.title: Create custom resource card
requirement.description: 'Add Custom Resource' opens 'Create Custom Resource'. Title is mandatory 1-100 characters (empty shows 'Please enter a title'), description optional max 500, 'Allow File Uploads' toggle (default ON), optional deadline ('Set a Deadline'). The card is stored with type CUSTOM and 'Resource created successfully!' is shown.

requirement.title: Who may create or update resources
requirement.description: Only the course owner and ACCEPTED CONTRIBUTORs can create/update resources and see 'Add Custom Resource'. VIEWERs and outsiders get 'Only course owner and contributors can create resources' / 'Only course owner and contributors can update resources'; unknown course/resource gives 'Course not found' / 'Resource not found'.

requirement.title: Delete resource (owner only)
requirement.description: Only the owner can delete resources: the API returns 'Only the course owner can delete resources' to everybody else. In the UI the delete button exists only for CUSTOM cards, asks 'Are you sure you want to delete this resource?' and shows 'Resource deleted successfully'. The 4 default cards have no delete button.

requirement.title: Attach files to a card
requirement.description: Files can be added (button 'Add Files' / 'Add More Files') only to cards with allowFiles = true and only by the owner or a CONTRIBUTOR. Otherwise the API returns 'This resource does not allow file uploads' or 'You don't have permission to add files to this resource'. File URLs must be valid URLs. Success shows 'Files added successfully'. Cards without files show 'No files uploaded yet'.

requirement.title: Upload size, type and count limits
requirement.description: courseResourceUploader accepts images, PDF and text up to 16MB (max 10 files), Word/Excel/PowerPoint up to 16MB (max 10 files), video up to 64MB (max 5 files), ZIP up to 32MB (max 5 files); anything else, any larger file or more files is rejected ('Failed to upload files: ...'). Upload requires a logged-in user ('Unauthorized').

requirement.title: Remove a file
requirement.description: Owner and CONTRIBUTOR can remove a file URL from a card; others get 'You don't have permission to remove files from this resource'. Only the chosen file is removed.

requirement.title: Deadline display
requirement.description: A card with a deadline shows 'Due: <MMM dd, yyyy 'at' h:mm a>'. Within the next 3 days it additionally shows the badge 'Soon' (amber); after the deadline it shows 'Overdue: <date>' (red) and no 'Soon' badge.

req_spec.title: UC-S4-005 Weekly Timetable with Events
req_spec.scope: Student creates timetables, adds weekly class events for favourite courses, detects conflicts, shares the timetable and receives class reminders. Source: UniShare_Iteration_4.md Use Case 5 (UC-S4-005); src/server/api/routers/timetable.ts; src/components/timetable/*; src/app/(student)/timetable/page.tsx; src/app/api/cron/class-reminders/route.ts. Differences from the document: events are weekly recurring by day-of-week (no recurrence rule JSON, end date or multiple days per event); the conflict message is 'Time conflict detected / Overlaps with <title> (start - end)'; reminders use the user's reminder timing (5-30 min, default 10) not a fixed 1 hour; the check 'start before end' and the conflict check are done only in the browser, not in the API.

requirement.title: Create timetable
requirement.description: 'Create Timetable' (or 'Create Your First Timetable' when the student has none: 'No Timetables Yet') needs a Name of 1-100 characters (API message 'Name is required') and an optional Description of max 500. The new timetable is listed under 'My Timetables' and the creator is the owner.

requirement.title: Default timetable
requirement.description: Timetable Settings > 'Set as Default' makes the timetable the student's default (button changes to 'Currently Default', badge 'Default'); /timetable opens the default timetable first. Only owner or accepted collaborator may set it ('You don't have access to this timetable'). Deleting or leaving the timetable clears the default.

requirement.title: Only favourite courses can be scheduled
requirement.description: 'Add Class' lists only the student's favourite courses ('Only your favorited courses are shown'). Without favourites the modal shows 'No Favorite Courses - You need to favorite courses before adding them to your timetable'. The API returns 'You can only add favorited courses to your timetable' for other courses.

requirement.title: Class event data
requirement.description: A class has Course (required), Title (required, 1-100), Day of Week (Sunday=0 ... Saturday=6), Start Time and End Time (HH:MM) and optional Location (max 100). It is stored as weekly recurring and appears in the week view on that weekday in the course colour. API: dayOfWeek 0-6, times must match ^\d{2}:\d{2}$ ('Invalid time format (HH:MM)').

requirement.title: End time must be after start time
requirement.description: If End Time is not later than Start Time the form shows 'End time must be after start time' and 'Add Class' is disabled; the equal-times case is also invalid. Dragging/resizing to an invalid range shows 'Invalid time range'. The API must also reject such events.

requirement.title: Time conflict detection
requirement.description: Two classes on the same weekday must not overlap (A.start < B.end and B.start < A.end). The form shows 'Time conflict detected' and 'Overlaps with <title> (<start> - <end>)' and disables 'Add Class'. Back-to-back classes (end = next start) and the same time on another weekday are allowed.

requirement.title: Maximum 3 classes per course per day
requirement.description: A course can have at most 3 classes on one weekday. With 3 existing the form shows 'Maximum 3 classes per course per day. This course already has 3 classes on this day.' and blocks submit; with 1 or 2 it shows 'This course has N class(es) on this day. You can add M more.'.

requirement.title: Edit and move a class
requirement.description: Owner and CONTRIBUTORs can edit a class (Class Details > Edit Class > 'Save Changes') or drag/resize it in the calendar. The same time-range and conflict rules apply, ignoring the class itself. Conflict while dragging shows 'Cannot move event: Time conflict with another class' / 'Cannot resize event: Time conflict with another class'.

requirement.title: Delete a class
requirement.description: Owner and CONTRIBUTORs can delete a class: 'Delete this class?' with 'Yes, Delete' / 'Cancel'. Yes removes the class from every week; Cancel keeps it.

requirement.title: Timetable permissions
requirement.description: Owner: everything. CONTRIBUTOR: add/edit/delete classes. VIEWER: read only, no 'Add Class'. Users without an accepted role cannot open the timetable ('You don't have access to this timetable'). API messages: 'You don't have permission to add events to this timetable' / '... update this event' / '... delete this event'.

requirement.title: Invite students to a timetable
requirement.description: Only the owner can invite ('Only the owner can invite collaborators') through Share > 'Search for students': the query needs at least 3 characters ('Search query must be at least 3 characters'), only APPROVED users are found (max 10), the owner and already invited users are excluded, role Viewer or Contributor. Inviting yourself ('You can't invite yourself') or an invited user ('User already invited') is rejected. A TIMETABLE_INVITATION notification 'New timetable invitation' is sent.

requirement.title: Accept, reject and leave a shared timetable
requirement.description: A PENDING invitation appears under 'Timetable Invitations' with Accept / Reject. Accept -> ACCEPTED and the timetable shows under 'Shared with Me'; Reject -> REJECTED. The owner is notified ('Invitation accepted' / 'Invitation declined'). A collaborator can 'Leave Timetable' (Confirm Leave); the owner cannot ('You cannot leave a timetable you own. Delete it instead.').

requirement.title: Class reminders
requirement.description: The cron endpoint /api/cron/class-reminders (Authorization: Bearer CRON_SECRET, else 401) creates a CLASS_REMINDER notification 'Class starting in <N> minutes' / '<course> at <HH:MM>' for owners and accepted collaborators when the class starts in N minutes (+-1), N = the user's reminder timing (default 10). At most one reminder per class and day.

requirement.title: Update and delete timetable (owner only)
requirement.description: Only the owner can rename/describe ('Only the owner can update this timetable') and delete ('Only the owner can delete this timetable') a timetable. Deleting removes its classes and collaborators and clears the default for every user who had it.
